# ContentAriaWidgetsPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `ContentAriaWidgetsElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Profile"**: tab. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `PROFILE_TAB`: `click().profile()`.
- **"Security"**: tab. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `SECURITY_TAB`: `click().security()`.
- **"Billing"**: tab. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `BILLING_TAB`: `click().billing()`.
- **"Can I run tests in parallel? +"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `CAN_I_RUN_TESTS_IN_BUTTON`: `click().canIRunTestsIn()`.
- **"Which browsers are supported? +"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `WHICH_BROWSERS_ARE_SUPPORTED_BUTTON`: `click().whichBrowsersAreSupported()`.
- **"Do I need a test id on every element? +"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `DO_I_NEED_A_TEST_BUTTON`: `click().doINeedATest()`.
- **"Bold"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `BOLD_BUTTON`: `click().bold()`.
- **"Italic"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `ITALIC_BUTTON`: `click().italic()`.
- **"Underline"**: button. In `ContentAriaWidgetsElements` as `UNDERLINE_BUTTON`: `click().underline()`.
